parsed.rationale: Both participating records are mock types named `MockArtworkService` living under test file paths (`NowPlayingServiceTests.swift` and `ArtworkServiceTests.swift`). The cluster's Jaccard similarity of 0.75 is consistent with two test-only mock doubles that share most of their shape because they stub the same service interface, but each exists to serve a distinct test suite (`AppServicesTests` vs `ArtworkTests`). Consolidating them would couple two otherwise independent test packages and risk making test isolation harder to maintain. Per the decision rules, all participating records are test fixtures, so no-action is warranted.
